messages:
maria (Docs): Quick question for SOC2 docs: drafting a concise migration note for customers moving from manual audit downloads to scheduled exports. Need a tiny curl + node snippet showing tenant scope, time-range, redact_level, export_ttl_seconds, and a one-line legal-approved sentence about downstream retention.

sam (Legal): Use this verbatim: "Exported audit datasets are snapshots at the time of export. Customers are responsible for downstream retention, deletion, and access controls; Redwood provides short-lived export links and encrypted delivery and does not assume custody of exported copies." Avoid words like "guarantee".

asha (Eng): Endpoints: POST /v1/audit/exports (tenant_id,start_ts,end_ts,redact_level,export_ttl_seconds,retention_cutoff_ts) + GET /v1/audit/exports/{id}/download. Add mask_fields for targeted redaction.

troy (DevEx): Example export_ttl_seconds=3600 in snippets and show streaming to file. Add a tiny note about large orgs using page_size.

lucy (Product): Call out: encrypted exports use customer KMS keys and may require client-side unwrap; link to KMS guide (TODO).

adeploy-bot: deploy queued for branch docs/audit-export-migration by asha  status: success

maria (Docs): Draft snippets (trimmed below) 

```bash
# create export
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/audit/exports" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -d '{"tenant_id":"acme","start_ts":1693526400,"end_ts":1693612800,"redact_level":"partial","export_ttl_seconds":3600}'
# download
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/audit/exports/EXPORT_ID/download" --output acme-export.jsonl
```

```js
// node streaming
const fs = require('fs'); const axios = require('axios');
(async()=>{ const r = await axios.get('https://api.redwood.example/v1/audit/exports/EXPORT_ID/download',{headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}`},responseType:'stream'}); r.data.pipe(fs.createWriteStream('acme-export.jsonl')); })();
```

maria (Docs): I'll add legal's sentence verbatim and a small checklist: scopes `audit:read`, `export:create` (optional `kms:decrypt`), export_ttl_seconds:3600, retention_cutoff_ts redacts older records. Will tag legal/product for sign-off and land PR.
